text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!
Look at meee!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
How's that, Taiki!? That's my running!
Did your heart go jumping out of your chest in terror?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Whether she truly jumped or not,
Seeking the Pearl's run certainly made me feel
her boundless potential."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With just a slight pump of motivation on the straight, what a magnificent burst of speed. In this form, even if her opponent is Taiki Shuttle...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful run, Pearl-san!
With a run like that—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: This year will surely be an all-you-can-victory buffet, yes! Do your best. —All by yourself♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huh? By myself...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you going to take me on?
As the giant wall meant to bounce me right back.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well, about that...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now then, it's time for the gate test.
Here we GOOO!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Craaash!!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Judge Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Number 14, Taiki Shuttle-san, disqualified~.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: This time for sure... This time for sure~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clatter-craaash!!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Again!? Whhyyy?

text_block_list.name: Judge Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Number 6, Taiki Shuttle, disqualified again~

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? You failed the gate
testttt? And twice at thattt!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees. Plus, due to conditioning delays,
her Make Debut won't be happening for a while.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: They told me it might be difficult to do it this year, yes.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: By the end of the year is... Wait, you...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Then what am I supposed to do with all this burning spirit that has nowhere to go?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry, Pearl-san.
In that case...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: As an apology, I'll give you a hug☆

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A hug! Well then!
I guess I can forgive you for that♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wait, a hug isn't gonna fill
the hole left by missing a race! Honestly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...An unexpected late start from Taiki Shuttle.
Looks like we'll need to drastically rethink our plans for the rest of the year.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer, it can't be helped now that it's come to this.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In the Junior Class, I'm just gonna run wild my own way!
I'll show off this brilliance of mine to my heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without Taiki Shuttle around,
Seeking the Pearl would undoubtedly be
the star leading this generation.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "So, Trainer. What's the next race I should aim for?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The plan was already clear.
With the greatest rival absent, there was nothing to fear—only to have her walk the main stage from GII straight to GI.
choice_data_list: Let's make our next race the Daily Hai Junior Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"The Daily Hai Junior Stakes..."
A major GII race.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Sure... That sounds fine. A race of high enough prestige to be worthy of me. And—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The leading role is as good as mine!
No other Umamusume can outshine me.
Ohohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl laughs triumphantly, but...
"I see. Taiki can't participate in any races for the rest of the year. Which means..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we might have a chance too,
Bright. A ray of hope might be shining through.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is true~, Dober. It is something
the Mejiro family is deeply grateful for~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "First, I was thinking of requesting a match myself~. Against the marvelous Lady Pearl, of course♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm leaving the vanguard to you, Mejiro.
Even if one person isn't enough for now—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let's win together against Pearl-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even without Taiki Shuttle, the fastest of all,
we can never let our guard down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the Daily Hai Junior Stakes, a first-time rival Umamusume awaits Seeking the Pearl.
